# Feature: MIG-014 Better Auth host accounts (remote-reachable mode)

<!-- auto-generated by /implement on 2026-10-23 -->

## Intent

Integrate approved Better Auth cookie sessions for remote-reachable hosts (GATE-02 Variant A): HttpOnly SameSite cookies, no JWT mint on the cookie profile, server-side actor/host/membership, fail-closed security misconfig.

## Preconditions

- GATE-02 APPROVED Variant A (cookies); GATE-03 APPROVED Variant B (Hono+Colyseus design choice)
- MIG-010/011/013 on main; host SQLite + Policy Service available
- Epic #773; no production cutover / Supabase shutdown

## Happy Path

- [ ] Registered remote account with valid host session restores the same Actor on login, page-reload whoami, and WebSocket handshake; session secrets are absent from DTOs and server logs
- [ ] Cookie profile: HttpOnly + SameSite; Secure when HTTPS; no JWT plugin; `/api/auth/token` hard-denied; Authorization Bearer rejected
- [ ] Stored membership (not client role/owner fields) determines authorize outcomes for player vs GM/owner

## Edge Cases

- [ ] Expired, revoked, or cross-host session → HTTP and WS deny; no project data mutation
- [ ] Player request with forged role/owner fields → no GM/owner elevation; membership still binds
- [ ] Remote-reachable misconfig (missing secret, JWT enabled, insecure cookie profile) → host fails closed before ready
- [ ] Touched files: zero type escape hatches (typed-strict)

## Regression

- [ ] MIG-010/011/012/013 self-tests still PASS
- [ ] Solo loopback identity file path remains for MIG-015; Supabase auth-context primary path unchanged (no cutover)

## Assumptions

- Full product Colyseus room/Hono command surface lands in later MIG tickets; this slice proves shared session resolution on HTTP + a minimal WS upgrade using the same auth port
- Frontend `auth-context.tsx` gains a non-default host cookie bridge (credentials include / no bearer store) without inventing new UX or retiring GoTrue
